sections.shortTitle: Punjab Transport Department Transport Authorities Service Rules 2012
sections.section: RULES - Punjab Transport Department (Transport Authorities) Service Rules 2012
sections.description:
PUNJAB TRANSPORT DEPARTMENT
PUNJAB TRANSPORT DEPARTMENT
(TRANSPORT AUTHORITIES) SERVICE
RULES, 2012
[Gazette of Punjab, Part I,
21st November, 2012]
No.
SOR-III(S&GAD)1-37/2006, dated 24-3-2012.---In exercise of the powers
conferred under section 23 of the Punjab Civil Servants Act, 1974 (VIII of
1974), Governor of the Punjab is pleased to make the following rules:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) These rules may be cited as the Punjab
Transport Department (Transport Authorities) Service Rules, 2012.
(2) They
shall come into force at once.
2. Method
of recruitment.---The method of recruitment, minimum qualification, age
limit and other incidental matters for the posts of the functional unit shall
be such as mentioned in the Schedule appended to these rules.
3. Repeal.---The
Punjab Transport Department (Secretary Regional Transport Authority) Service
Rules 1998, are hereby repealed.
